checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Same face, markings, tail, black ears/paws; the bike fox is slightly more realistic in the muzzle, and the reading fox is a bit different in head shape. Overall consistent.
Orange hoodie with drawstrings and blue jeans in all three.

must.item: Bike in park, baking cookies in kitchen, reading under tree
must.why: All three scenes are clear and correct.

must.item: Flat cartoon style and no text
must.why: Flat outlined style; no text. The bike picture has slightly more gradient and detail, but it is still consistent.

faults.what: The bike picture's fox has a more realistic, narrower face, and its pose is slightly awkward: the hands look stuck on the bars and the legs are hidden.
The reading picture has a plain white background on the left and the fox is small, so it looks unfinished.
The kitchen picture is busy and its shading is slightly different from the reference.

summary: Three consistent square flat-cartoon pictures of the fox in the orange hoodie, matching the requested scenes with no text; only minor style and background inconsistencies.
